scenario: [LSER.16.2.1] / [LSER.14.1]: `count all_time` is exact from the first observation onward with no forgetting, on the running-stats backing (SeriesBackendWelfordEwma, [LSER.18.1]), and a cold `count` is the typed zero rather than `null` ([LSER.19.8]). Values 7, 8, 9 one per pump, each read pre-sample ([LSER.8.6.1]): the cold read logs 0, then 1, then 2. Drives the companion read `s.count` through the SeriesBackendWelfordEwma query in both runtimes: libds `welford_ewma.c`'s count and the Mercury `ds.series` `agg_count` over the all-time samples.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    dev: String key
    level: Int mutable

series Reading.level (by: dev):
    count all_time

rule r:
    Reading s where s.count >= 0
->
    log info "count {s.count}"
